name: Jibneiah
title: Benjaminite clan leader after the exile
summary: Jibneiah was a son of Jeroham and belonged to the tribe of Benjamin. He is mentioned in the book of Nehemiah as one of the Benjaminite leaders who settled in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile. He played a role in rebuilding the Jewish community in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among Benjamin's descendants in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Jibneiah is listed as one of the Benjaminite leaders who settled in Jerusalem after returning from exile, as part of the rebuilding of the community.

keyEvents.title: Parallel genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jibneiah is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as part of the tribe of Benjamin, confirming his place in Israel's tribal history.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem after the exile
keyEvents.description: As part of the organized settlement following the return from Babylon, Jibneiah was among those who voluntarily took up residence in the holy city to restore its population.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding the Jewish community
keyEvents.description: Jibneiah was part of the generation that worked to rebuild the Jewish community in Jerusalem under the leadership of Nehemiah and Ezra.
